answer: Concrete sybil resistance via bridge escrow: every identity crosses a verification bridge in 3 co-signed steps, each witnessed by a staked peer who risks 2,000 POA on the outcome. A live pulse heartbeat every 40 seconds proves the operator runs real hardware, and missed pulses decay the crossing. Rewards unlock in an oasis pool only after 25 epochs of steady pulses and 9 distinct witnesses. An attacker running N sybils must fund 9N witness stakes of 2,000 POA plus 25 epochs of uninterrupted pulses per head, so total cost scales quadratically and detection compounds.
